The proposed correction is scientifically appropriate.

I independently confirmed both samples have **byte-identical HEPEvt files and truth ledgers**, with **10,000 unique IDs 0–9999**, identical truth vectors, generation seed, electron mass and illumination. Their differing parent-manifest hashes and source revisions do not invalidate physical pairing.

Replace metadata equality with **separately pinned, required parent hashes and full revisions for each sample**. Preserve all existing physical-input, geometry/material, readback and worker checks; reject missing or mismatched parent identities.
